methods.label: Information lost through grouping
methods.explanation: After grouping, the class midpoint replaces each data value in that class, so the specific values are lost. Thus, the result is only an estimate and may be too high or too low.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 grouped-data estimation and the meaning of the arithmetic mean.
